Message:
The horde of creatures
has an alpha.
If I eliminate it,
that will destabilize the horde,
and make bringing down
the rest easy.

After all, I must
take every measure
to make it back
to Fortina in time.

I chased after
the wounded alpha,
all the way into a cave.
But...

The instant I pierced
the alpha with my lance,
a black fog suddenly
spread out all around me.

I turned back in
the direction of Alexandra’s voice,
when the mouth of the cave
started collapsing onto itself.

Wait—with only these boulders
blocking the way,
my lance should be enough...

When I raised my lance...
I felt my strength
suddenly leave my body.

It hurts to breathe...
Don’t tell me...
that black fog was...
poison?!

“Ghh... But, I have a promise
to keep...to Fortina...”

With no strength left in me,
my legs gave in,
sending me crashing
to the ground.
